profile.headline: Web Developer at Waste Management
profile.summary: Experienced Web Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the environmental services, Non-Profit, and Toll-Roads industry. Skilled in PHP, LAMP-Stack Development, IBM Rational System Architect, and Backbone.js. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Computer Science from Texas State University.

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description:
- Working in a team of 4 developers using Zend Framework in a LAMP stack environment.
- Front-end uses Bootstrap Framework, with PHP, Ajax, Javascript, Jquery, and SAAS.
- Back-end PHP and MySql. And Git for continuous integration.
- Learning SalesForce Lightning, SAI and Power Bi.

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description:
- Worked in a team to develop a complete Toll Road Software package, Including the Admin Panel  using Bootstrap, Backbone, RESTful API, and Git as the project repository.
- Developed large scale interactive and responsive sites using Javascript frameworks. 
- Developed the Back Office System for a state agency and fixed GUI bugs in a large scale web project.
- Worked in a team to develop the front-end interactive site of a client using PHP, Javascript, Jquery, SAAS CSS, HTML and JSP. I also collaborated in the development of the Spanish version of site.
- Worked closely with PM and Software engineers to develop highly interactive Single Page Application (SPA) architecture.
- Participated in daily Agile scrum.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed 2 ecommerce shops using zen-cart. One wholesale and one retail.
- Fully customized both shops using PHP, HTML, CSS, Javascript, and JQuery in a LAMP (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP)  environment.
- Maintain 3 other company sites, using a proprietary CMS system

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Updated the company intranet, and databases.
- Developed reusable components for easier implementation between several sites.
- Developed interactive tools using ASP, JQuery, SQL, CSS and HTML.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Worked with customer requirements and turned them into fully responsive, standards compliant, cross-browser web sites.
- Collaborated with team in daily Agile scrum.
- Participated on a collaborative team developing the web site redesign of www.schwab.com.
- Applications were build in a proprietary CMS system using custom Javascript, and Ajax protocols.
- Manipulated API and JSON files to meet dynamic approach to menu driven applications.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed custom GUI applications, banner templates, and site templates based on user requirements.
- Used best practices to develop UI/UX based on customer and client feedback.
- Customized proprietary applications using Javascript, JQuery, HTML, CSS, API and other proprietary tools.
- Collaborated with engineering team and other developers in a daily Agile scrum.

positions.title: System Support / Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained the company's main site and Intranet using JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, HTML, Perl, and CSS in Linux.
- Provided Hardware and Software support to corporate office personnel and 40 medical facilities (Unix, AS 400, Windows Servers).
